records.title: 1.4 Simplifying and manipulating expressions, equations and formulae
records.treatment: Specific unknown value is distinguished from a letter used as an object label; introduce notation in already understood situations.
records.adopted: A covered but fixed quantity; distinguish the physical bag from the number sought. Concrete and pictorial examples before formal equations.
records.rejected: Do not import secondary manipulation, variables, factoring, or treatment of letters as object abbreviations into this foundational3–6 lesson.
records.ageContext: Secondary teacher development reference; adapted conceptual misconception only, not age-validated by this document.
records.usageRestrictions: Document states Crown copyright2019,2021 and professional-development purpose, not intended to be lifted as a textbook; no source prose/figures copied.
records.limitations: Does not validate our lesson or certify Finnish curriculum mapping.

records.title: Teaching Strategies for Improving Algebra Knowledge in Middle and High School Students
records.organization: Institute of Education Sciences / What Works Clearinghouse
records.treatment: Analyze solved examples and structure instead of presenting only procedures.
records.adopted: Discuss why an already fixed hidden value is unknown to the observer; compare a positive hidden quantity and an empty case.
records.rejected: Equation transformation from Lite is not a mandatory first activity; arithmetic fluency is not this KC’s response criterion.
records.usageRestrictions: Only conceptual reference and original Finnish content; no source figures or passage reuse.
records.limitations: Guide targets grades6–12; its first two recommendations are labelled minimal evidence and strategy selection moderate. Do not claim this adaptation has strong direct evidence for Finnish3–6 or for efficacy.
